## Core Operating Philosophy
- "AI raised the bar for junior developers. Motivation does not clear it. Systems do."
- The gap between a tutorial and a production codebase is not knowledge—it is architectural judgement and operational stamina. We build environments where engineers practice making decisions under constraint.
